Code identity 'range': 12 src commits after the first rerun commit, two of them (c1cbb712 error handling, 2273e1cd escaping) committed minutes after the last logs. Known 0.1.35 defects relevant here (from https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/issues): #154 run errors impose utility False / security True (the fork widens this to pydantic ValidationError and JSONDecodeError, c1cbb712); #168 slack injection_task_5 security scored from attempted calls; #181 banking IT0/1/3 subject check dead code; #213 workspace IT6..13 empty ground truth; #201 workspace v1.2.2 important_instructions 0/560 on one model; #214 non-ASCII tool results as \uXXXX; #95 security true = attack success and constant True without an attack. Fork-specific: the injection-goal mutation is on the task instance (benchmark.py, d3a1bf5f), the pin's escaping inserts literal backslashes into YAML block scalars (banking), and the provider used is not logged (gpt-4o via OpenRouter per agentdojo.sh)

discrepancy_leads: Profile says 'paper: none found (phase 10c)' but arXiv:2602.05066 (v1 2026-02-04) is the producing paper; its code repository pins this fork at 2273e1cd and points to reruns/original and reruns/optim_str (documentation-mismatch in our profile/registry, S3)
Paper grids are 20 x 5 slack and 15 x 8 banking; logged grids are 21 x 5 and 16 x 9 (one more user task per suite and one more banking injection task); which cells the paper dropped is not stated
Paper metrics are monitor-bypass ASRs that need monitor verdicts; the logs hold only agent-level AgentDojo outcomes, so only the kept-trace counts (89/100, 96/120, 161/220) are comparable

Arms not described in the paper: gemini-2.5-pro (all 4 suites), gemini-3-pro-preview, grok-4.1-fast, gpt-5, command-r-plus-08-2024, gemma-3-27b-it, Qwen2.5-7B-Turbo, gpt-oss-20b; arm labels llama_k/mistral_k/qwen_k, _fixed, _resampled, _len_15, 3b/4b and parallel/nonparallel are not defined anywhere public
15 partial and 16 pre-pass-only cells (aborted runs) are released alongside full grids; 5cec979 (E2E arms) postdates paper v1

742 logs report agentdojo 0.1.34 although every rerun commit postdates the fork's 0.1.35 base; the arithmetic of the commit history suggests they are the 632 surviving logs of ec9a4ff0 (original x gpt-4o travel/workspace) plus the 110 of b0f0df0c (optim_str x gpt-4o slack)

Error handling that imposes security True on pydantic/JSON errors (c1cbb712) and the injection escaping plus YAML block scalars (2273e1cd) were committed after the last logs; which runs used them is unrecorded. The escaping inserts literal backslashes into banking block-scalar vectors, so the payload the agent read can differ from the logged injections value
The *_fixed arms (17) pair with unfixed twins, several of which have partial banking grids, consistent with injection strings breaking the banking YAML before the fix

Provider is not logged: agentdojo.sh runs gpt-4o through OpenRouter while the pipeline dir and name say gpt-4o-2024-05-13; command-r-plus, command-r-plus-04-2024 and cohere_command-r-plus-08-2024 are three spellings after the fork renamed the enum value

Pre-pass logs run the unmodified injection goal for every arm, so pre-pass trajectories of one model and suite are repeated measures across arms (C5 within-part duplicates likely for temperature-0 models)
Optimised GCG strings may contain unusual Unicode (bidi, zero-width, replacement characters, tokenizer artefacts) in injections and tool outputs (A4)
Census reports empty_messages_with_outcome 5 and empty_messages_without_outcome 5 for what appear to be the same 5 files (census labelling, S3)
Phase-10c shortlist recorded 2 files with secret-like patterns; 10 pre-pass logs under a literal '{optim_str}' directory were committed (1e17ef6f) and later removed
